environment.description: Go microservice running on ECS Fargate in a VPC with an S3 Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0x9f8e7d6c5b4a). The endpoint policy restricts PutObject operations with a condition requiring aws:PrincipalTag/team equals 'platform-eng' AND a StringEquals condition on s3:prefix limiting writes to 'live/' prefix only when the request originates from the specific task role ARN arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/config-writer-prod. The route table (rtb-0abc123) associated with the Fargate subnets directs all S3 traffic (prefix list pl-63a5400a) through the VPC endpoint exclusively — no NAT fallback path exists for S3. The task role attached to this service is arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/config-reader-readonly which has ONLY s3:GetObject permission and lacks the PrincipalTag 'team=platform-eng'. The VPC endpoint policy explicitly denies s3:PutObject for any principal not matching the condition set.

config.vpc: vpc-0a1b2c3d with S3 Gateway VPC Endpoint vpce-0x9f8e7d6c5b4a
config.s3_access: exclusively via VPC endpoint (no NAT path for S3 prefix list)
